description: This file defines common utilities, data structures, and macros used in the ANGLE project's shader translator component, including custom string, vector, map types, and memory management utilities.

classes.name: TVector
classes.description: A vector container using a custom pool allocator.

classes.name: TUnorderedMap
classes.description: An unordered_map container with a custom pool allocator.

classes.name: TMap
classes.description: A map container with a custom pool allocator.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Converts an integer to a TString.

methods.name: AllocatePoolCharArray
methods.description: Allocates a null-terminated char array in the global memory pool.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes and returns a stream imbued with the classic locale.
